title: Browser extension
subtitle: Pair the Dome extension to save contacts, notes and links from Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
bridge_desc: Dome listens on localhost so the extension can send captures while the app is open.

code_expires: Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share it.
